notes.title: A Crown Was Shattered. A World Was Unmade.
notes.content:
The People vanished. The kings turned to stone. Now, only you remain.

Welcome to [b]Riven Crown[/b], a brutal new Souls-Fighter where the elegance of a fighting game collides with the decay of mythic fantasy.

You are the fallen. Dead in one world, reborn in a fractured higher realm, a place shaped by ancient kings, corrupted civilizations, and false gods who no longer answer.

This is not just another action RPG. This is precision. Pattern. Memory. Every block, every combo, every kill is earned.

[b]Combat Is Prayer. Mistakes Are Punishment.[/b]

[list]
[*] Dual-Blocking System – Stand or crouch. Guess wrong, and fall.
[*] Super State – Charge your meter and unleash a second phase of deadly speed and power.
[*] Weapon-Specific Combos – Learn each weapon's rhythm. Perfect the inputs. Punish with precision.
[*] Kick, Slam, Shatter – Use the environment to crush enemies and break their guard.
[*] Prisoner Rescue Mechanic – Save lives. Power your super. Call upon the freed in battle.
[*] Equipment-Bound Abilities – Every weapon and armor carries a unique ability. Equip it, and it's yours for as long as you wear it. Use it long enough, and the skill becomes permanent, even after unequipping. Build mastery through loyalty.
[/list]

[b]A Living World of Secrets[/b]

The world is broken but it remembers.

[list]
[*] Discover four lost civilizations and the petrified rulers who once shaped them.
[*] Break codes in a weekly cipher mini-game solve real-world puzzles and earn rewards.
[*] Influence your ending by what you find, what you believe, and what you choose to leave behind.
[/list]

Riven Crown is being crafted by a small but seasoned team, fueled by obsession, memory, and a desire to challenge what a Souls-like can be.

[b]Wishlist Riven Crown[/b] today. Step into the ritual.
